title: The Life of Christ
description: The Gospels on screen: the Nativity, the public ministry, the Passion and the Resurrection.

title: Our Lady
description: Films about the Blessed Virgin, and about Lourdes, Fátima and the people who saw her.

title: Lives of the Saints
description: Biographical films about canonised saints and the beatified, from the Middle Ages to the twentieth century.

title: Martyrs and Persecution
description: Catholics who died for the faith, and the regimes and mobs that killed them.

title: Priests
description: Parish priests, confessors and missionaries: the priest at the altar, in the confessional and in trouble.

title: Monks, Nuns and Friars
description: The cloister, the convent and the friary: vows, community and contemplative prayer.

title: Missionaries
description: Priests, religious and lay Catholics carrying the faith abroad.

title: The French Revolution
description: The persecution of the Church in revolutionary France, including the Vendée and the Carmelites of Compiègne.
gap: The War of the Vendée (2012) and Vaincre ou mourir (2023) are in the grey area: the first has no independent review yet, and historians fault the second for its partisan framing.

title: The Cristero War
description: Mexico's persecution of the Church in the 1920s and the Catholic uprising against it.
gap: No film yet. For Greater Glory (2012) is not included because its boy martyr, José Sánchez del Río, was canonised after the Council, and no older feature about the war has yet been found with enough criticism behind it.

title: The Spanish Civil War
description: The killing of priests, religious and laity in Spain between 1936 and 1939.
gap: No film yet. Un Dios prohibido (2013), about the Claretian martyrs of Barbastro, is not included because they were beatified after the Council. Older Spanish films are still under review.

title: The English Martyrs
description: Catholics put to death under the Tudors and Stuarts, from Thomas More to the seminary priests.
gap: Still under review: the documentary Faith of Our Fathers and a film about St John Houghton.

title: For Families
description: Films suitable for watching with children. Read the notes on each film first.

title: Comedies
description: Catholic comedy: stubborn priests, unworldly friars and nuns who will not take no for an answer.

title: Documentaries
description: Non-fiction films about Catholic history, places and religious life.
gap: No film yet. Into Great Silence and No Greater Love show religious life as it is lived after the Council and are not included. The Portuguese Fátima documentaries of the 1940s are still under review.

title: Television and Miniseries
description: Longer stories made for television, mostly European saints' lives.
